description: This file defines the OrderProvider class, a state management class for handling order state, including active order tracking, polling for status updates, and persistence via storage service in a Flutter app.

classes.name: OrderProvider
classes.description: Provides order state management, including loading, updating, and polling order status.

methods.name: _startPolling
methods.description: Initializes a timer to periodically fetch order status updates.

methods.name: loadActiveOrder
methods.description: Loads the current active order from storage and begins polling for updates.

methods.name: setActiveOrder
methods.description: Sets a given order as active and persists its ID.

methods.name: clearActiveOrder
methods.description: Clears the active order and cancels polling.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancelling the polling timer.
